같은 판정도, 공정하다는 느낌은 달라질 수 있어요.
그래서 보이는 몸보다 피격 영역을 작게 잡기도 합니다.
빨간 공격 영역, 히트박스와 겹쳐야 체력이 줄죠.
셀레스트도 공개 코드에서 이동용 충돌 영역보다 피격 영역의 높이가 작아요.
몸만큼 넓히면 맞고, 조금 줄이면 빗나갑니다.
겉모습은 그대로고, 피격 영역만 바꾼 겁니다.
하지만 무조건 작게 만든다고 좋은 건 아닙니다.
너무 줄이면 맞아 보이는 공격까지 무시해서 어색해지겠죠.
핵심은 피했다고 느낄 수 있는 작은 여유예요.
아까 살아남은 이유도, 보이는 몸이 아니라 이 두 영역으로 판정했기 때문입니다.

factAndVisualGuards: Do not claim all players always prefer favorable outcomes or cite the comments as research.
Do not claim a specific enemy has a rigged hitbox, or that Celeste's authors stated this precise fairness motive, unless independently established by a primary source.
The public Celeste collider constants establish separate geometries, not the exact current state/version or every spike's collision rule.

Avoid saying all attacks simply hit whenever any two drawn rectangles overlap: game-specific extra conditions can exist. The actual overlap rule here refers to our clearly identified Unity demonstration.
On real footage, editorial outlines and code-based reconstructions must be named; no fabricated live detector, measured confidence score or internal runtime readout.
No reference-video-creator framing, source-lesson assets or comment-avatar reuse in the final narration/UI.
No list of invincibility frames, coyote time, hitstop or tunneling techniques in this one-mechanism Short.
userEvidence: 이런느낌으로 내용을 강조해서 만들어줘. 실제 게임영상도 가져와서 히트박스 위에 그려서 보여주기도 하고1분짜리 쇼츠 만들어봐
narrationEn: That clearly touched. Why was there no hit?
The attacker says, “Why did that miss?” The survivor says, “Nice dodge!”
The same hit decision can feel more or less fair.
One design choice is to make the hurtbox smaller than the visible body.
The green damage-receiving region is the hurtbox.
Health drops when it overlaps the red attack region, the hitbox.
Celeste’s published code also defines a hurtbox shorter than its movement collision box.
As wide as the body: a hit. Slightly smaller: a miss.
The appearance is unchanged. Only the hurtbox changed.
But making it smaller is not always better.
Make it too small and attacks that look like hits pass through, which feels strange.
The point is a little room to feel that you dodged it.
That character survived because these two regions decided the hit, rather than the visible body.
